ctx.replace-image.note: ledger row ctx.replace-image — ctx-menu-on-image pre: ReplaceImage routes applyObjectOp("replace-image") -> insertImage(), which opens the #image-dialog insert-pop

ctx.convert-to-shape.note: ledger row ctx.convert-to-shape — ctx-menu-on-image pre: ConvertToShape calls openShapePicker(selectedObject()), which opens #shape-dialog with the shape options (commit via selectShape + #btn-shape-ok is post-dialog interaction)

ctx.rotate.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row ctx.rotate — WO has no Rotate ctx item at all; the census maps the capability to the right-panel #rp-image-rotate (applyImageRotate90). The ctx-menu-on-image pre DOES satisfy the image pick (lastObjectPick), but the #right-panel aside stays hidden until its View rail toggle is clicked and no contract pre opens it, so the control never reaches a hit-testable state.

ctx.edit-points.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row ctx.edit-points — LOUD registered divergence (Phase 5/WO-22): no vector contour model in the web editor, so the handler only dispatches the wo:edit-points window marker event and setStatus NotAvailable; no dialog/DOM/style mutation exists for any contract assertion to observe.

ctx.edit-object.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row ctx.edit-object — editSelectedObject() requires a div.object placeholder (isEditableObject); the ctx-menu-on-image fixture is a plain , so the handler is setStatus-only inert and #object-dialog never opens. Would need a div.object placeholder fixture pre.
